Invite people · optional
  Each person gets their own sign-in, chats and projects; you choose who is an admin.
<QR>
  1. Invite someone
     The invite is a link and a code, for one person, good for 7 days. Send it to them yourself.
     On the hub:
       fleetd invite --name <name>
       --role admin for another admin.
<QR>
  In the app: Settings › Hub › People.
–  Invite people optional · fleetd init --step people

Run fleetd init --step people again when you've done it; it keeps what's done.
